programmes.funder: Government of Nepal with development partner support
programmes.amount_note: Matching-grant challenge fund supporting innovative private-sector business models, typically in agriculture, agri-processing and rural livelihoods. Grant sizes and match ratios are set per call.
programmes.deadline_note: Delivered through periodic competitive calls tied to donor-funded programmes; check the Ministry of Industry, Commerce and Supplies and partner programme websites for the live call.

eligibility.other_note: Nepal-registered private enterprises and cooperatives; matching contribution required. Verify the currently active window, as these funds are donor-programme dependent.

programmes.name_local: Nepal Academy of Science and Technology (NAST) research and innovation grants
programmes.name_en: Nepal Academy of Science and Technology (NAST) research and innovation grants
programmes.funder: Nepal Academy of Science and Technology (NAST)
programmes.amount_note: Research and technology development grants to Nepali researchers, innovators and small enterprises. Amounts are set per call and are typically modest.
programmes.deadline_note: Announced through periodic calls on nast.gov.np.

programmes.funder: Industrial Enterprise Development Institute (IEDI), Ministry of Industry, Commerce and Supplies
programmes.amount_note: Concessional loan of up to NPR 20 lakh based on approved project size, at 3% interest per year, repayable over up to 5 years with early repayment allowed without penalty. Disbursed in instalments.
programmes.deadline_note: The programme opens via a public notice with a 21-day submission window; timing varies by announcement cycle and annual budget allocation. Recent rounds have been heavily oversubscribed, with over 5,000 applications.
programmes.reopen_note: Run annually since fiscal year 2079/80 subject to budget allocation. Monitor iedi.gov.np and Ministry of Industry, Commerce and Supplies notices for the next 21-day window.

procedure_steps.detail: Wait for the public notice announcing the application window.
Submit the online application with the project proposal within 21 days.
Evaluation and scoring by the project selection committee.
Approved applicants are referred to a partner bank for disbursement at 3% interest.

eligibility.other_note: Business must be registered as a firm, company, partnership or cooperative in Nepal, operating for less than 10 years, with annual turnover below NPR 15 million, demonstrating innovation and use of modern technology. Import-based trading businesses, blacklisted companies, unregistered entities and holding or investment companies are ineligible. Eligible sectors include agriculture and livestock, IT and digital innovation, infrastructure and transport, social services and tourism, and traditional or local resource-based enterprises.

programmes.name_local: युवा तथा साना व्यवसायी स्वरोजगार कोष
programmes.name_en: Youth and Small Entrepreneur Self-Employment Fund
programmes.funder: Youth and Small Entrepreneur Self-Employment Fund, Government of Nepal
programmes.amount_note: Collateral-free concessional loans channelled through partner banks, cooperatives and microfinance institutions to young entrepreneurs and small businesses. Ceilings are set by the fund's operating directive.

eligibility.other_note: Nepali youth and small entrepreneurs applying through a partner financial institution. Not a technology-startup-specific instrument.
